title: Count the partitions
prompt: This program asks Spark about its cores and about the partitions of `api_requests`, before and after a `repartition`. What does it print? Type each line on its own line.
hints: Spark here runs as `local[2]`, and `defaultParallelism` follows the number of cores.
`repartition(3)` gives back a new DataFrame with exactly 3 partitions.
`repartition` never changes `api_requests` itself, so it still has the partitions it was read with.
